summary: Full backend+frontend E2E testing of HERA Turni iteration 2 (frequency routes, Turno Domenica, recovery flow, pinned routes). 24/24 pytest passed. Frontend UI verified for all new features. Found & fixed 1 backend bug: POST /shifts/{id}/recover returned 500 due to Motor injecting ObjectId `_id` into the response dict. Applied minimal fix (pop _id before return).

issues: Radix Dialog warning: Missing DialogDescription (a11y-only, not functional). Same warning still present from iteration 1 on SubstitutionModal was fixed; a new dialog (route form) triggers it now.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to the Nuovo/Modifica giro dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py recover_shift() had a serialization bug: passed the same dict to `insert_one` then returned it — Motor mutates the dict adding a BSON ObjectId under `_id`, which FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize (produced 500). Fixed by popping _id before returning. Note: generate_shifts() has the same pattern (insert_many + subsequent iteration over `shifts` list) but does not return the mutated docs, so it is currently safe; still, follow best practice of inserting a copy.

route_days_for_week frequency branch: when start_date is None uses `i % interval == 0` which biases Monday. Acceptable for demo but if a user creates a frequency giro on Wednesday without start_date, cadence is still Mon-anchored — consider defaulting start_date to route creation date on the backend.

seed()/ensure_extras() split still non-idempotent for the mario.rossi driver user (line ~562): would fail on 2nd startup if drivers wiped but users retained (unique email index). Not triggered in this iteration but same concern from iter1.
Deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown handlers — migrate to lifespan context manager.

Frontend testids: generate-shifts-btn (dashboard header, unique), recover-btn (SubstitutionModal for uncovered shifts), route-mode-select, route-interval-input, route-start-input, route-pinned-switch, route-slot-select (domenica auto-locks days to [6]). Sunday row appears only if shifts exist for domenica.
rca of the issue: recover_shift 500 RCA: `await db.shifts.insert_one(new_shift)` — Motor's insert_one mutates the passed dict by injecting the inserted `_id` (BSON ObjectId). The function then `return new_shift`, so FastAPI attempted to JSON-serialize the ObjectId and raised TypeError -> 500. Fix: `new_shift.pop('_id', None)` before return (or insert a `dict(new_shift)` copy).
